subject: LLM suitability playbook + performance links (next steps)
summary: Post-discovery thread: shared Redwood-verified perf profiles and prompt sets, recommended model variants for Orbital Health's summarization and triage workloads, flagged potential quality regression risk on long-context notes, agreed on a 2-step eval (sandbox perf + 3-day quality pilot) and sent mutual action plan for procurement.
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@orbitalhealth.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@orbitalhealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: model recommendations and performance links

Hi Emma / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the two immediate asks so we keep momentum: 

1) Recommended models (based on what you described: patient note summarization + triage routing):
   - rdl-1.7b-q4 (fast, low cost for short summaries) — good for high TPS, ~95th p99 latency 120ms at 8k tokens/sec observed in our hosted tests.
   - rdl-4.9b-fp16 (better quality on medical terminology, modest cost) — p50: 55ms, p95: 180ms at typical batch sizes for your workload.
   - rdl-7b-ctx32k (for long-note context, more expensive) — used for recall-sensitive scenarios; note below on regression risk.

2) Links and artifacts (attached + shared):
   - Redwood-verified performance CSV (attached): per-model TPS, p50/p95/p99 latencies observed on NVLink A100 pools.
   - Prompt set samples (attached) — initial sets we recommend for your summarization eval.
   - Sandbox perf dashboard: https://redwood.app/benchmarks/rdw-20270412-orbital

Quality/regression note: when moving from rdl-4.9b-fp16 to rdl-7b-ctx32k we sometimes see hallucination modes on long, fragmented clinical notes if prompt-conditioning isn't adjusted. We recommend a small prompt calibration pass plus the 3-day quality pilot below before any production rollout.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- You: share a representative sample of de-identified notes (5k tokens total across ~200 notes) or allow us to pull via secure upload.
- Redwood: spin up a 7-day sandbox with the three recommended model variants, run throughput/latency bench, and produce quality scoring (ROUGE/clin-F1 + human spot checks).
- Procurement: we will provide a short SOW and pricing tiers once the pilot scope is agreed.

I attached an action-plan workbook (orbital-action-plan.xlsx) with timelines and point owners. If that looks good I’ll loop in Solutions to schedule the sandbox by next Tue.

Thanks — Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

---
Attachments: redwood-verified-profiles.csv (CSV, 42 KB); prompt-set-samples.txt (TXT, 8 KB); orbital-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 14 KB)
